phrases.text: Two new captains, a new update, and a map that changed overnight. This is everything that happened in Fortnite this week.
All of it straight from Epic's own in-game news and Item Shop, from November 8th to November 14th.
Let's get into it!
First, the update. On November 12th, the game went from version 43.00 to version 43.10.
And the map changed with it. The official map went from 17 places to 16.
Three places are gone: Fortune's Fort, Loot Lagoon and Boogie Boat.
And two new ones showed up.
Buggy's Beachhead, a new named location in the north of the map, closest to Lantern Landing.
It sits about 60 meters from where Loot Lagoon used to be.
And Nami's Tangerine Grove, a new landmark in the south-west of the map, about 200 meters from Windmill Village.
So here's the map as it stands today: 11 named locations. Quick tour, clockwise from the north.
Buggy's Beachhead, in the north of the map.
Cursed Cavern, in the east of the map.
The $.$. Rocky, in the east of the map.
Busy Bay, in the south-east of the map.
Plunder Port, in the south of the map.
Loguetown, in the south of the map.
Windmill Village, in the south-west of the map.
Arlong Park, in the west of the map.
Lantern Landing, near the center of the map.
The Chest, in the north-west of the map.
Rubber Resort, in the north of the map.
Plus 5 landmarks, including the new one, Nami's Tangerine Grove.
Captain number one. On November 8th, this tile went up.
A new Captain has sailed in!
Face the Lil Uzi Vert Boss to earn Lil' Uzi Vert Jr.,
and get ahead with the lightning-fast Lil Uzi Vert's Lil' SMG.
Then on November 13th, the Lil Uzi Vert Bundle hit the Item Shop.
It's 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 7,100, with 12 items, and it stays until December 12th.
Inside: two outfits, 3 backpacks, 2 emotes, 2 pickaxes, and even a pair of shoes.
Captain number two showed up the same day as the update, November 12th.
A new Captain has claimed territory!
Defeat the Buggy Boss, claim the Transponder Snail Sprite,
and explode into action with the Special Buggy Ball.
And as of today, Buggy is in the Item Shop too, at 1,600 V-Bucks.
And his new spot on the map, Buggy's Beachhead, is the one we saw up north.
Quick one: if you're grabbing anything from the Item Shop this week, use code BAD. It really helps the channel.
The Straw Hats were in the news every single day this week.
When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer!
Set sail with Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits and chart a course to uncharted waters.
In today's shop: Luffy and Roronoa Zoro at 1,800 V-Bucks each, Nami and Usopp at 1,600.
Zoro was in the shop all 7 days this week.
And the Devil Fruits are still out there.
Rare Devil Fruits have dropped in across the map!
Eat the Gum-Gum Fruit to stretch your skills as Luffy,
or the Flame-Flame Fruit to come in hot as Ace...
just stay away from water.
Along with this emote tile, still just three words.
GUM-GUM GATLING!
This island tile was up almost all week. It dropped out on November 12th, and came back the next day.
Explore One Piece's Arlong Park, sail past Baratie Bay,
or storm The $.$. Rocky on this mysterious skull-shaped island.
Arlong Park is in the west of the map.
Baratie sits right next to Busy Bay.
And The $.$. Rocky is in the east of the map.
Over in Festival, a new Music Pass went into the news on November 12th.
Virtual Diva Kasane Teto takes the stage!
TWINDRILL DIVA Music Pass holders get access to the Kasane Teto Outfit, Back Bling, Emote, and more.
Dive into Festival to start unlocking rewards!
And the Treasure Tab tile was back from November 9th to the 11th.
All great adventures begin with a treasure map!
Head to the Treasure Tab to follow along with weekly progress and chart your next move.
Two more big bundles came and went in the shop this week.
The Masters of the Universe Bundle, with He-Man, Skeletor and She-Ra, was in from November 10th to the 13th, at 3,600 V-Bucks, listed at 6,700.
And the Mega Man Bundle, in since November 11th, is 3,800 V-Bucks, listed at 7,300.
It leaves the shop after November 15th, so tomorrow is the last day.
It has 10 items, and it even comes with Rush as a sidekick.
Quick recap. Version 43.10, three places gone and two new ones, led by Buggy's Beachhead.
Lil Uzi Vert and Buggy as the new captains, both now in the shop,
and one last day tomorrow for the Mega Man Bundle.
Which captain are you going after first? Tell me in the comments!
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
